reviewer_role: Independent numerical construct-diagnostic review plus bounded static003 plan review
decision: 002C numerical outputs are reproducible and may be adopted as post-result descriptive construct-overlap diagnostics. The003 fixed patient-level two-axis computation is methodologically reasonable; interpretation of resulting patterns must follow the clarifications below, communicated to root before this review. The reviewer did not amend the frozen plan.

numerical_review.inferential_unit: 23 distinct patients, 8 endoscopic healing and15 nonhealing; no cell/sample duplication.

Mann_Whitney.method: Independent dynamic programming of rank-subset counts, cross-checked with SciPy exact Mann-Whitney; no normal approximation.

numerical_review.Spearman_method: Pearson correlation of average ranks, asymptotic t reference with n-2 df because ordinal endpoint ties; not exact Spearman P
numerical_review.delta_endoscopic_sign: followup minus baseline; negative values are endoscopic improvement

patient43.direction: Omitting patient43 increases the positive coefficient; patient43 does not create or solely drive the positive association.

numerical_review.diagnostic_model_reconstruction: SVD reconstruction from the permitted patient table with healing, baseline candidate and inflammation change, including analytic leverage/CookD and all23 leave-one-patient-out fits.

002C_interpretation_limits: AUC=.925 describes empirical contemporaneous group separation using a post-minus-baseline molecular score; it is not a baseline prediction validation, and no ROC threshold was selected in this review.

The reported correlations and exact rank test are post-result descriptive diagnostics. Their nominal P values are not a newly prespecified confirmatory family and do not change GSE23597 primary support=false.
Candidate change versus endoscopy change uses post-minus-pre for both variables. Negative rho means higher candidate change accompanies a lower endoscopic score.

Baseline Mayo has only values2/3 and19of23 are3. The near-zero baseline Pearson correlation is range-restricted and cannot prove an absent biological association; a significant post correlation and nonsignificant baseline correlation do not themselves test a difference between those correlations.

Patient43 is a nonhealing patient with a large positive candidate change. Its omission increases the adjusted positive coefficient from1.194691 to1.345934, so it cannot be described as creating the positive association. It remains included.

Strong separation and correlation are consistent with construct overlap but do not establish measurement equivalence, histologic identity, causality, or that a molecular score is redundant with every clinical measurement.

In patient_level_source.tsv, estimate and p are joined LOPO results for omitting that row patient, not patient-specific effect estimates or P values. The n_above_healing_min field uses an inclusive at-or-above comparison; the two nonhealing IDs43/45 exceed the cutoff under either convention.

003_static_plan_review.scope: Static plan only. No GSE282122 expression X, sample-by-state counts, or cell-level data read in this bounded review. The stated metadata counts/chemistry crosswalk were not independently re-derived here.
supported_design_elements: Patient is explicitly the inferential unit: within-site post-minus-pre quantities followed by equal-site patient means. The41 site pairs are not treated as41 independent patients.
Missing clinical outcomes are excluded from outcome contrasts and are not relabeled nonremission.
Captured CT composition and within-released-CT-state pseudobulk expression are specified as parallel axes, with frozen labels and candidate genes rather than outcome-driven reclustering.

Pseudobulk sums count genes and all-gene libraries by sample/state; no cell-level inferential P values are specified. The20-cell threshold and10/50 sensitivities are fixed before this expression analysis.
The symmetric two-group decomposition is explicitly descriptive algebra on a separate linear normalized scale, not causal mediation.

The plan names the adalimumab clinical-remission and follow-up differences, forbids using this cohort to decide why the IFX endoscopic GSE73661 association occurred, and forbids replacement validation.

The plan explicitly states all remitters are v3.1 and mandates a v3.1-restricted sensitivity. It does not claim chemistry adjustment resolves every batch/time difference. All-remitters-in-v3.1 alone does not prove mathematical complete confounding or prove a chemistry-adjusted model is rank deficient; actual overlap must be reported.
Two named exploratory main contrasts have a specified BH family; auxiliary cell sets, thresholds and denominators remain sensitivities, not candidates for smallest-P selection.

required_interpretation_clarifications.issue: A positive composition test and an unstable/nonsignificant within-CT test do not establish composition dominance.
required_interpretation_clarifications.requirement: A composition-dominant description needs magnitude/uncertainty from the decomposition and comparable evaluable patients/sites; lack of state evidence alone is not evidence of zero state change.

required_interpretation_clarifications.issue: The phrase does not transfer is too definitive when neither pattern is supported.
required_interpretation_clarifications.requirement: Use not supported or inconclusive in this distinct context unless interval-based evidence excludes a prespecified materially relevant transfer. Do not derive absence from nonsignificance.

required_interpretation_clarifications.issue: The other-epithelial group contains multiple states, so its within-group mean change can include changes of its subtype composition.
required_interpretation_clarifications.requirement: Call the components changes between and within the two coarse groups, not proof of cell-intrinsic regulation. Within-CT changes also remain conditional on the released broad state definition.

required_interpretation_clarifications.issue: Enumerating every label assignment is computationally exact but does not make labels exchangeable or remove outcome-chemistry confounding.
required_interpretation_clarifications.requirement: State the exchangeability assumption and descriptive status of full-cohort permutations; retain the v3.1 sensitivity and residual batch/time caveat. Do not claim exact permutation makes the association independent of chemistry.

required_interpretation_clarifications.issue: A zero epithelial denominator is an absent measurement, and cell-count eligibility may create different analysis sets for the two axes.
required_interpretation_clarifications.requirement: Require positive epithelial denominator in both visits; if zero, mark that composition endpoint non-evaluable rather than assigning logit0 from pseudocounts. Report patient/site attrition and common evaluability, and use the same evaluable subset when comparing axes. This is a technical validity guard, not an outcome-based exclusion.

003_static_plan_review.disposition: Clarifications were sent to root before final review. They can be recorded in an appended interpretation/technical amendment without overwriting the existing frozen plan or changing its scientific contrasts. Unsupported dominance/nontransfer/causal claims are not approved by this review.

scientific_selection_scope: No new feature, patient, threshold, state, normalization, model or outcome was selected by the reviewer. No new significance-seeking analysis was performed.
mutation_scope: Only dedicated new002C reviewer script, log, numeric output and this review were written. Frozen003 plan and all earlier scientific outputs remain unchanged.
